title: Architect Launches Liquid Inference, a Real-Time Auction for LLM Inference
summary: Architect Financial Technologies has launched Liquid Inference, an LLM router that runs a live auction for every request. Liquid Inference is an LLM inference marketplace from Architect where providers bid to serve each prompt. The buyer pays the lowest offer that meets its rules.
